title: 一辆小吉普，救完两关的人：赤色要塞实战
description:
开小吉普炸营房、救俘虏、升级火箭，再把人送到直升机坪，完成两关救援。
画面录于2026-10-04，是历史开发实录；片中玩法、操作和问题属于当时版本，当前试玩以游戏内提示为准。
粉丝向非官方赤色要塞重制，原作版权归Konami。
当前试玩（复制到浏览器打开）：https://www.zhengxiaohui.cn/html/game/jackal-stage1-3d/index.html

en.title: One Little Jeep, Two Rescue Missions | Jackal 3D Gameplay
en.description:
Drive a little jeep, open barracks, rescue prisoners, upgrade rockets and deliver everyone to the helipad across two stages.
Edited development footage recorded on 2026-10-04. Features, controls and issues shown belong to that earlier build; the current demo may differ.
Chinese narration with reviewed English subtitles. The game interface is currently in Chinese; follow the current in-game control prompts.
Fan-made, unofficial Jackal remake. Original game rights belong to Konami.
Current browser demo: https://www.zhengxiaohui.cn/html/game/jackal-stage1-3d/index.html
